text_en: It seems you are ready, brave soldier.
I cannot intervene, not in your battles nor that creature's, but I will open the temple door for you.
It is done. Do not waste time, save this world and, with it, your own people.
You have gathered many souls and become stronger. If anyone can try to stop Ratatosk, it's you.
I thought you wanted to save this world. You won't survive a minute in the heat here without proper equipment.
I won't open the door until you're suitably prepared.
